title: Term Life Insurance: Conversion to Quarterly Direct Billing When the Bank-Draft Privilege Ends
content:
**System reference card — Term Life Insurance billing.**

## When it applies

When a Term Life Insurance policy's monthly bank-draft privilege ends because its returned bank drafts reach the product's returned-draft limit, Ashgrove converts the policy to quarterly direct billing and sets the converted quarterly installment. The policy then carries quarterly mode, no monthly draft day, and the converted quarterly installment as its installment premium.

| Business effect | After the conversion |
|---|---|
| Premium mode | quarterly direct billing |
| Monthly bank-draft day | cleared |
| Installment premium | the converted quarterly installment |
| Anything else on the policy | unchanged |

## Invocation: `convert_to_quarterly_billing_2bfb08af`

**Capability.** Converts one Ashgrove term policy from monthly bank-draft billing to quarterly direct billing: the policy's premium mode becomes quarterly, its monthly bank-draft day is cleared, and its installment premium becomes the quarterly installment supplied. Nothing else on the policy changes.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. Unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `term_policy_id` | The reference number of the term policy being converted, read from the term policy lookup before the call | Identifier, as recorded |
| `new_modal_premium` | The quarterly installment premium to record | USD, a non-negative amount with 2 decimal places; the tool rounds half to even to the cent if more decimals are given |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("converted" on success), `term_policy_id`, `premium_mode` (always "quarterly"), `modal_premium` (the recorded installment in USD with 2 decimal places) and `eft_draft_day` (always None, the draft day having been cleared). Afterwards the policy record shows the quarterly mode, no draft day and the new installment premium.
